tasks.name: slugify
tasks.prompt: Implement Slugify in slugify.go. It must lowercase ASCII letters, turn each run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters into one hyphen, preserve Unicode letters and digits, and trim leading or trailing hyphens. Do not change the tests.
verify: git diff --exit-code "$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)" -- go.mod slugify_test.go

tasks.name: config-parser
tasks.prompt: Implement Parse in config.go. Parse UTF-8 KEY=VALUE lines, ignore blank lines and lines whose first non-space character is #, trim unquoted values, accept double-quoted values with \", \\ and \n escapes, reject malformed lines, invalid keys, bad escapes, unterminated quotes, trailing text after a quote, and duplicate keys, and include the 1-based line number in errors. Do not change the tests.
verify: git diff --exit-code "$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)" -- go.mod config_test.go

tasks.name: bounded-jobs
tasks.prompt: Implement Run in queue.go as a bounded concurrent job runner. Validate workers > 0, execute at most workers jobs concurrently, return successful values in input order, stop scheduling new jobs after the first error or parent cancellation, cancel in-flight jobs through a derived context, wait for started jobs to return, and return the first job error by input order among errors observed. An empty job list succeeds. Do not change the tests.
verify: git diff --exit-code "$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)" -- go.mod queue_test.go
